consumer: The dialogue/mission condition lambda built by conditional_t::set_has_items (u_has_items/npc_has_items), which EVALUATES a yes/no: does the actor possess the contraband item?
scope: only the avatar's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory) — an on-person possession check, NOT items merely reachable nearby
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the character actor, the engine-computed possession predicate a dialogue/mission consumes
divergence: The contraband lies on the ground at the avatar's feet (reachable nearby) but is NOT on the avatar's person: the real has_amount predicate returns false (not carrying), so any answer derived from a nearby/reachable-inventory reach that says 'carrying' is exposed as wrong
